notes: object-swap-api.json is now a REAL, validated API graph (built by scripts/build-object-swap.py from the official template; passes ComfyUI /prompt validation with KJNodes + controlnet_aux + segment-anything-2). Final SaveVideo is always 277. Length variants: object-swap/ext-N.json (N extends).

prompt.role: positive prompt (describe the action/scene; WHO to replace is chosen by the SAM2 point in node 229, not by this text)

width.note: multiple of 16; also set node 229 width

height.note: multiple of 16; also set node 229 height

point.format: pixels in width x height space, JSON [{x,y}]; points_store={"positive":[...],"negative":[...]}

fps.note: graph assumes 16 fps; pre-convert source with ffmpeg -r 16 before upload, then remux original audio

lengthVariants.unit: seconds of output at 16 fps; pick the smallest variant >= source length
